title: MLEADERSTYLE maximum leader-points writer domain

scope.operation: Validate direct MLEADERSTYLE group-90 maxLeaderPoints values before output.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.87 maps group 90 to maximum leader points. Autodesk AcDbMLeaderStyle::setMaxLeaderSegmentsPoints documents -1 as unlimited and otherwise requires values >= 2. The libdxfrw DRW_MLeaderStyle model has an existing default of 0; preserve that value for compatibility without claiming native semantic acceptance.
scope.claim_boundary: Direct-writer group-90 value admission and emitted integer only; no MLEADER rendering, mutation API, or whole-style semantic claim.

implementation: Accept -1, the library's compatibility default 0, and values >= 2.
Refuse values below -1 and the documented invalid value 1 before publication.
Preserve the caller and existing destination on refusal.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.accepted_output: Every selected accepted value is emitted as the exact group-90 signed integer.
evidence.refusal: Each selected invalid value preserves the destination sentinel and caller field.
evidence.retry: Each refusal is followed on the same adapter by value 2 and exact group-90 output.
evidence.matrix: Four accepted values × three target versions × two encodings; three invalid values × three versions × two encodings with refusal and retry.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE integer, source-presence, dependency and native semantic profiles remain open; P2 remains open.
